accept.name: Accept
accept.summary: Media types the client is willing to receive, in order of preference (q-values).

accept-ch.name: Accept-CH
accept-ch.summary: Lists the Client Hints the server wants the browser to send on subsequent requests.

accept-charset.name: Accept-Charset
accept-charset.summary: Character encodings the client understands. Deprecated: browsers no longer send it.

accept-encoding.name: Accept-Encoding
accept-encoding.summary: Content codings (gzip, br, zstd, deflate) the client can decode.

accept-language.name: Accept-Language
accept-language.summary: Natural languages the client prefers, e.g. en-US,en;q=0.9.

accept-patch.name: Accept-Patch
accept-patch.summary: Media types the server accepts in a PATCH request body.

accept-post.name: Accept-Post
accept-post.summary: Media types the server accepts in a POST request body.

accept-ranges.name: Accept-Ranges
accept-ranges.summary: Whether the server supports range requests and in which unit (usually bytes).

access-control-allow-credentials.name: Access-Control-Allow-Credentials
access-control-allow-credentials.summary: Allows the response to be exposed to frontend JS when the request carried credentials.

access-control-allow-headers.name: Access-Control-Allow-Headers
access-control-allow-headers.summary: Request headers allowed in the actual cross-origin request (preflight response).

access-control-allow-methods.name: Access-Control-Allow-Methods
access-control-allow-methods.summary: HTTP methods allowed for the actual cross-origin request (preflight response).

access-control-allow-origin.name: Access-Control-Allow-Origin
access-control-allow-origin.summary: Which origin may read this response cross-origin: one origin, * or null.

access-control-expose-headers.name: Access-Control-Expose-Headers
access-control-expose-headers.summary: Response headers that frontend JS is allowed to read on a cross-origin response.

access-control-max-age.name: Access-Control-Max-Age
access-control-max-age.summary: How long (seconds) a preflight result may be cached by the browser.

access-control-request-headers.name: Access-Control-Request-Headers
access-control-request-headers.summary: Sent in a preflight: the headers the actual request will use.

access-control-request-method.name: Access-Control-Request-Method
access-control-request-method.summary: Sent in a preflight: the method the actual request will use.

age.name: Age
age.summary: Seconds the response has been sitting in a proxy or CDN cache.

allow.name: Allow
allow.summary: Methods supported by the target resource (required on 405 responses).

alt-svc.name: Alt-Svc
alt-svc.summary: Advertises alternative services for this origin, e.g. HTTP/3 on another port (h3=":443").

alt-used.name: Alt-Used
alt-used.summary: The alternative service the client is currently using.

authorization.name: Authorization
authorization.summary: Credentials for the server: Basic, Bearer token, Digest, AWS signatures, etc.

cache-control.name: Cache-Control
cache-control.summary: Caching directives for browsers and shared caches: max-age, no-store, private, immutable…

clear-site-data.name: Clear-Site-Data
clear-site-data.summary: Asks the browser to clear cookies, storage and/or cache for this origin.

connection.name: Connection
connection.summary: Hop-by-hop connection options (keep-alive, close, upgrade). Forbidden in HTTP/2.

content-disposition.name: Content-Disposition
content-disposition.summary: Whether the body is shown inline or downloaded as an attachment, with a filename.

content-dpr.name: Content-DPR
content-dpr.summary: Device pixel ratio of the served image (legacy Client Hints).

content-encoding.name: Content-Encoding
content-encoding.summary: Codings applied to the body (gzip, br, zstd). The client must decode in reverse order.

content-language.name: Content-Language
content-language.summary: Natural language(s) of the intended audience of the body.

content-length.name: Content-Length
content-length.summary: Size of the body in bytes, after content coding.

content-location.name: Content-Location
content-location.summary: An alternate URL for the returned content.

content-range.name: Content-Range
content-range.summary: Where a partial body belongs in the full representation, e.g. bytes 0-1023/4096.

content-security-policy.name: Content-Security-Policy
content-security-policy.summary: Restricts which scripts, styles, frames and connections the page may load or make.

content-security-policy-report-only.name: Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only
content-security-policy-report-only.summary: Like CSP, but only reports violations without enforcing them.

content-type.name: Content-Type
content-type.summary: Media type of the body, e.g. application/json; charset=utf-8.

cookie.name: Cookie
cookie.summary: Cookies previously set by the server (via Set-Cookie) sent back with the request.

critical-ch.name: Critical-CH
critical-ch.summary: Client Hints that are critical: the browser retries the request if they were missing.

cross-origin-embedder-policy.name: Cross-Origin-Embedder-Policy
cross-origin-embedder-policy.summary: Requires cross-origin resources to opt in (CORP/CORS) before the document may embed them.

cross-origin-opener-policy.name: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy
cross-origin-opener-policy.summary: Isolates the browsing context group from cross-origin popups/openers.

cross-origin-resource-policy.name: Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy
cross-origin-resource-policy.summary: Limits which origins may load this resource (same-site, same-origin, cross-origin).

device-memory.name: Device-Memory
device-memory.summary: Approximate device RAM in GiB (Client Hint).

downlink.name: Downlink
downlink.summary: Approximate effective bandwidth in Mbps (Client Hint).

dnt.name: DNT
dnt.summary: Do Not Track preference (deprecated, ignored by most sites).

early-data.name: Early-Data
early-data.summary: Set by an intermediary when the request was sent in TLS 1.3 early data (0-RTT).

ect.name: ECT
ect.summary: Effective connection type: slow-2g, 2g, 3g or 4g (Client Hint).

etag.name: ETag
etag.summary: Opaque version identifier of the resource, used for conditional requests.

expect.name: Expect
expect.summary: Expectations the server must meet, typically 100-continue before sending a large body.

expires.name: Expires
expires.summary: Date after which the response is considered stale. Ignored when Cache-Control max-age is set.

forwarded.name: Forwarded
forwarded.summary: Standard form of X-Forwarded-*: original client IP, host and protocol seen by proxies.

from.name: From
from.summary: Email address of the human controlling the user agent (used by crawlers).

host.name: Host
host.summary: Host and port of the target server. Required in HTTP/1.1 (:authority in HTTP/2).

if-match.name: If-Match
if-match.summary: Only perform the request if the resource's ETag matches (optimistic locking).

if-modified-since.name: If-Modified-Since
if-modified-since.summary: Only return the body if the resource changed after this date; otherwise 304.

if-none-match.name: If-None-Match
if-none-match.summary: Only return the body if the ETag differs; otherwise 304 Not Modified.

if-range.name: If-Range
if-range.summary: Make a range request conditional: send the range only if the resource is unchanged.

if-unmodified-since.name: If-Unmodified-Since
if-unmodified-since.summary: Only perform the request if the resource has not changed since this date.

keep-alive.name: Keep-Alive
keep-alive.summary: Parameters (timeout, max) for a persistent HTTP/1.1 connection.

last-modified.name: Last-Modified
last-modified.summary: When the origin believes the resource last changed; used with If-Modified-Since.

link.name: Link
link.summary: Typed links to related resources: preload, preconnect, pagination (rel=next)…

location.name: Location
location.summary: Target URL of a redirect (3xx) or of a newly created resource (201).

max-forwards.name: Max-Forwards
max-forwards.summary: Limits the number of proxies a TRACE/OPTIONS request may traverse.

nel.name: NEL
nel.summary: Network Error Logging policy: report failed fetches to a reporting endpoint.

no-vary-search.name: No-Vary-Search
no-vary-search.summary: Query parameters that don't affect the response, for cache key matching.

origin.name: Origin
origin.summary: Origin (scheme, host, port) that initiated a CORS or POST request.

origin-agent-cluster.name: Origin-Agent-Cluster
origin-agent-cluster.summary: Requests that the document be placed in an origin-keyed agent cluster.

permissions-policy.name: Permissions-Policy
permissions-policy.summary: Enables or disables browser features (camera, geolocation…) for the page and its frames.

pragma.name: Pragma
pragma.summary: Legacy HTTP/1.0 caching directive (no-cache). Superseded by Cache-Control.

priority.name: Priority
priority.summary: Requested response priority (urgency u=0..7, incremental i) for HTTP/2 and HTTP/3.

proxy-authenticate.name: Proxy-Authenticate
proxy-authenticate.summary: Authentication scheme a proxy requires (sent with 407).

proxy-authorization.name: Proxy-Authorization
proxy-authorization.summary: Credentials for authenticating with a proxy server.

range.name: Range
range.summary: Requests only part of the resource, e.g. bytes=0-1023.

referer.name: Referer
referer.summary: Address of the page that linked to or requested this resource.

referrer-policy.name: Referrer-Policy
referrer-policy.summary: Controls how much referrer information is sent with requests from this page.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.summary: Non-standard: reload or redirect after a number of seconds.

report-to.name: Report-To
report-to.summary: Defines reporting endpoints (legacy; replaced by Reporting-Endpoints).

reporting-endpoints.name: Reporting-Endpoints
reporting-endpoints.summary: Named endpoints that receive CSP, NEL and other browser reports.

retry-after.name: Retry-After
retry-after.summary: How long to wait before retrying (with 429, 503 or a redirect).

rtt.name: RTT
rtt.summary: Approximate round-trip time in ms (Client Hint).

save-data.name: Save-Data
save-data.summary: The user opted into reduced data usage.

sec-ch-prefers-color-scheme.name: Sec-CH-Prefers-Color-Scheme
sec-ch-prefers-color-scheme.summary: User's preferred colour scheme: light or dark (Client Hint).

sec-ch-ua.name: Sec-CH-UA
sec-ch-ua.summary: Browser brands and significant versions (User-Agent Client Hints).

sec-ch-ua-arch.name: Sec-CH-UA-Arch
sec-ch-ua-arch.summary: CPU architecture of the device, e.g. x86 or arm (Client Hint).

sec-ch-ua-full-version-list.name: Sec-CH-UA-Full-Version-List
sec-ch-ua-full-version-list.summary: Full version for each browser brand (Client Hint).

sec-ch-ua-mobile.name: Sec-CH-UA-Mobile
sec-ch-ua-mobile.summary: ?1 if the browser is on a mobile device (Client Hint).

sec-ch-ua-platform.name: Sec-CH-UA-Platform
sec-ch-ua-platform.summary: Operating system name, e.g. "Windows" or "macOS" (Client Hint).

sec-fetch-dest.name: Sec-Fetch-Dest
sec-fetch-dest.summary: What the response will be used for: document, script, image, empty (fetch/XHR)…

sec-fetch-mode.name: Sec-Fetch-Mode
sec-fetch-mode.summary: Request mode: navigate, cors, no-cors, same-origin or websocket.

sec-fetch-site.name: Sec-Fetch-Site
sec-fetch-site.summary: Relationship between initiator and target: same-origin, same-site, cross-site or none.

sec-fetch-user.name: Sec-Fetch-User
sec-fetch-user.summary: ?1 when the navigation was triggered by a user activation.

sec-gpc.name: Sec-GPC
sec-gpc.summary: Global Privacy Control: the user does not consent to their data being sold or shared.

sec-purpose.name: Sec-Purpose
sec-purpose.summary: Why the request was made, e.g. prefetch or prerender.

sec-websocket-accept.name: Sec-WebSocket-Accept
sec-websocket-accept.summary: Server's proof that it accepted the WebSocket handshake (hash of the client key).

sec-websocket-key.name: Sec-WebSocket-Key
sec-websocket-key.summary: Random nonce the client sends to open a WebSocket handshake.

server.name: Server
server.summary: Software used by the origin server, e.g. nginx or cloudflare.

server-timing.name: Server-Timing
server-timing.summary: Server-side performance metrics shown in browser devtools (db;dur=53).

service-worker-allowed.name: Service-Worker-Allowed
service-worker-allowed.summary: Broadens the scope a service worker script may control.

set-cookie.name: Set-Cookie
set-cookie.summary: Stores a cookie in the client, with attributes like Expires, Path, Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite.

sourcemap.name: SourceMap
sourcemap.summary: Link to a source map for the served JavaScript or CSS.

strict-transport-security.name: Strict-Transport-Security
strict-transport-security.summary: HSTS: forces HTTPS for this host (and optionally subdomains) for max-age seconds.

te.name: TE
te.summary: Transfer codings the client accepts; in HTTP/2 only 'trailers' is allowed.

timing-allow-origin.name: Timing-Allow-Origin
timing-allow-origin.summary: Origins allowed to see detailed Resource Timing values for this response.

trailer.name: Trailer
trailer.summary: Names of header fields that will be sent as trailers after the body.

transfer-encoding.name: Transfer-Encoding
transfer-encoding.summary: Hop-by-hop body framing, usually chunked. Not used in HTTP/2.

upgrade.name: Upgrade
upgrade.summary: Asks to switch protocols on this connection, e.g. to websocket.

upgrade-insecure-requests.name: Upgrade-Insecure-Requests
upgrade-insecure-requests.summary: The client prefers an encrypted, authenticated response (HTTPS upgrade).

user-agent.name: User-Agent
user-agent.summary: Identifies the client application, OS and version.

vary.name: Vary
vary.summary: Request headers that affect the response; caches must key on them (e.g. Accept-Encoding).

via.name: Via
via.summary: Proxies the message passed through, added by each intermediary.

viewport-width.name: Viewport-Width
viewport-width.summary: Layout viewport width in CSS pixels (legacy Client Hint).

want-content-digest.name: Want-Content-Digest
want-content-digest.summary: Asks the server to include a Content-Digest of the body.

content-digest.name: Content-Digest
content-digest.summary: Digest (e.g. sha-256) of the message content, for integrity checks.

warning.name: Warning
warning.summary: Deprecated: extra information about possible problems with the message.

www-authenticate.name: WWW-Authenticate
www-authenticate.summary: Authentication method(s) the server requires to access the resource (sent with 401).

x-content-type-options.name: X-Content-Type-Options
x-content-type-options.summary: nosniff: forbid the browser from MIME-sniffing away from the declared Content-Type.

x-dns-prefetch-control.name: X-DNS-Prefetch-Control
x-dns-prefetch-control.summary: Enables or disables DNS prefetching for links on the page.

x-forwarded-for.name: X-Forwarded-For
x-forwarded-for.summary: De-facto standard: originating client IP and the chain of proxies.

x-forwarded-host.name: X-Forwarded-Host
x-forwarded-host.summary: De-facto standard: the original Host requested by the client.

x-forwarded-proto.name: X-Forwarded-Proto
x-forwarded-proto.summary: De-facto standard: the protocol (http/https) the client used to connect.

x-frame-options.name: X-Frame-Options
x-frame-options.summary: Whether the page may be framed (DENY / SAMEORIGIN). Superseded by CSP frame-ancestors.

x-powered-by.name: X-Powered-By
x-powered-by.summary: Non-standard: the framework or runtime behind the server (often removed for security).

x-request-id.name: X-Request-ID
x-request-id.summary: Non-standard: unique id used to correlate a request across services and logs.

x-requested-with.name: X-Requested-With
x-requested-with.summary: Non-standard: XMLHttpRequest when sent by many JS libraries.

x-xss-protection.name: X-XSS-Protection
x-xss-protection.summary: Legacy XSS filter control. Deprecated; modern browsers ignore it — use CSP instead.

:authority.name: :authority
:authority.summary: HTTP/2 pseudo-header: the target host and port (replaces Host).

:path.name: :path
:path.summary: HTTP/2 pseudo-header: path and query of the target URL.

:scheme.name: :scheme
:scheme.summary: HTTP/2 pseudo-header: the URL scheme (http or https).

:status.name: :status
:status.summary: HTTP/2 pseudo-header: the response status code.

:protocol.name: :protocol
:protocol.summary: Extended CONNECT pseudo-header (RFC 8441), e.g. websocket over HTTP/2.
